scheme_name: Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedkar Loan for Higher Study in Foreign Countries
other_conditions: Minimum 50% marks in graduation for postgraduate, Ph.D., higher level research and computer courses
Minimum 50% marks in class‑12 (or equivalent qualifications such as recognized ITI or three‑year diploma) for technical and professional courses abroad
Loan can be given to a maximum of two persons from the same family
Approval is processed only after visa and air ticket have been issued
The foreign institution must be recognized by its government and the degree accepted there
Repayment starts 6 months after course completion and must be completed within 10 years
Applicant must furnish a valid surety
Application must be made within six months of moving abroad
If the beneficiary settles abroad, any change of residence, contact details, or email must be reported until the loan is fully repaid
benefits_summary: A loan of up to ₹15 lakhs at 4% interest is provided to eligible students.
